author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Playtest Launch Trailer for Heir of the Moon, a third-person open-world nature game developed by Redwater. Players will roam the lands as an apex predator on a survival adventure. Raise a pack of your own, hunt animals, and continue the bloodline by any means necessary. Heir of the Moon is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Playtest available now on Steam.
title: Heir of the Moon - Official Playtest Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a deep dive into the gameplay of Warfactory in this latest trailer for the upcoming automation RTS where production defines the war effort. The new video gives a closer look at core elements of gameplay: manufacturing and combat. In Warfactory, build assembly lines to forge an army of machines, then feed thousands of units into massive real-time battles where every loss must be replaced by your factory. Warfactory will be available on PC in 2027. You can join the playtest via Steam if you're interested.
title: Warfactory - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the new trailer for Knock Off: The Battle for Imagination, an upcoming 2D toy-box fighting game where action figures come to life in a world inspired by ’80s and ’90s playtime mayhem. The new trailer showcases gameplay as toys duke it out! In Knock Off: The Battle for Imagination, Johnny’s toys were never name-brand, but they were always legendary. When Maximus, Johnny’s first official brand-name action figure, arrives and shakes up the arena, Johnny’s beloved bootleg toys must prove that off-brand doesn’t mean outmatched.
title: Knock Off: The Battle for Imagination - Official Trailer #2

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a peek at tactical gameplay and more from Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2 in this teaser trailer for the upcoming spooky occult creature collector RPG featuring 3v3 tactical battles. Build your roster of Creepy Horrors in this creature collector RPG. Crawl through crypts collecting blood, guts, and gore, combining these grisly ingredients to summon Horrors and wield them in merciless 3v3 battles against rival cults. The Crypts are calling. Will you answer? Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2 will be available on PC (Steam). A demo is coming soon.
title: Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2 - Official Teaser Trailer

description: The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion Remastered is available now on Nintendo Switch 2, and this new trailer showcases features you can use as you explore Cyrodiil. Check out the latest The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion Remastered trailer to see the Nintendo Switch 2 features, including Joy-Con 2 motion controls, mouse and touchscreen mode, and traditional input options.
title: The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion Remastered - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Features Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Leave it to luck? Not a chance. Check out the Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor launch trailer for another look at this expansion for the action-adventure game. Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor brings two story chapters set in 1905 Sicily starring Enzo Favara alongside Ennio Salieri, new Free Ride mode challenges, jobs, weapons, outfits, vehicles, and horses. Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor expansion is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC. 

Sicily – Winter, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his.

At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the volatile underworld of the Valle Dorata, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

Additionally, the Mafia: The Omertà Co
title: Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor - Official Launch Trailer

title: Fortnite x Sonic the Hedgehog - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Welcome Demon is a decision-based management game where you play as a Warden of a prison beyond all worlds. Each day, demons arrive, confess their sins, and you decide where they belong. Watch the Welcome Demon gameplay trailer for a look at this upcoming game inspired by games like Papers, Please. Welcome Demon will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Welcome Demon - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Stick it to the Stickman will leave Early Access and version 1.0 will be available on PC on September 23, 2026. Watch the latest Stick it to the Stickman trailer to see gameplay and more from this physics-based brawler game. In Stick to the Stickman, you fight heaps of red stickmen to become the boss. Choose from hundreds of unique moves to construct the perfect combat machine and fight your way to the top of the corporate ladder. Version 1.0 of Stick it to the Stickman brings two new game modes and new content.
title: Stick it to the Stickman - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The fight is everywhere. Here's a peek at the Entrenched level coming to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 in this latest trailer. Entrenched is a single-player Campaign mission that will be available during both weekends of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Beta. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (BattleNet, Steam, Xbox on PC), and Xbox Series X/S on October 23, 2026. The single-player campaign will be playable a week early on October 16 with pre-orders of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official 'Entrenched' Campaign Trailer

description:
Watch the new teaser trailer for Worlds of Play: The Game Art Exhibition, an upcoming art exhibition featuring 20+ game studios and 40 games. Worlds of Play: The Game Art Exhibition will run from August 27-29, 2026 in Cologne, Germany.

The new teaser showcases games as part of Worlds of Play, including Arena Breakout, DayZ, Arma Reforger, PUBG, Delta Force, Control: Resonant, Cronos: The New Dawn, Sunborn Girls' Frontline Series, Light and Night, Wuthering Waves, Atomic Heart, Black Myth: Wukong, Honor of Kings, Honor of Kings: Ace, Honor of Kings: World, Phantom Blade Zero, TeamFight Tactics, Golden Spatula, League of Legends, League of Legends: Wild Rift, Valorant, and Valorant Mobile.
title: Worlds of Play: The Game Art Exhibition - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Hot on the heels of its disturbing reveal trailer that showcased your character being chased around a dark and decrepit house by a very tall, terrifyingly supernatural woman is seven minutes of brand-new gameplay from Rehaunted, a new first-person psychological detective horror game where every clue you investigate in this strange house seems wrong somehow. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4538140/Rehaunted/
title: Rehaunted: 7 Minutes of Extremely Creepy Gameplay

author: GameTrailers
description: The Watcher is a surveillance simulator set in a psychological thriller world. You play an unknown observer watching the residents of an apartment building across the street, in the strange city of Z, part of the totalitarian State of Nodia. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4982920/The_Watcher?utm_source=IGN&utm_campaign=announcement&utm_medium=article
title: The Watcher: Official Announcement Trailer

description: Meet Noctis (from Final Fantasy 15) and see this character in action in the latest Final Fantasy Resonance trailer for the upcoming RPG. Battle alongside Noctis in Final Fantasy Resonance. Resonate with his Vision within the Sanctum of Light and unleash his abilities in combat. Final Fantasy Resonance will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC on October 22, 2026.
title: Final Fantasy Resonance - Official Vision: Noctis Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a behind-the-scenes look at the upcoming Battlefield 6 x Top Gun collaboration in this latest video. Join the developers and Top Gun film franchise stars Miles Teller ("Rooster"), Charles Parnell ("Warlock"), and Lewis Pullman ("Bob") as they discuss how their characters and 9G cockpit performances were brought to life in Battlefield 6 in this new video for the upcoming collaboration between the action shooter game and Top Gun. The new video also gives us a look at the F-74A Seacat, a new mission to Gauntlet called Fighter Sweep, and Carrier Strike. New vehicles, new modes, and new maps are coming to the Battlefield 6 x Top Gun collaboration update. The Battlefield 6 x Top Gun event free update will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam) on August 18, 2026.
title: Battlefield 6 x Top Gun - Official Gameplay Deep Dive Video

author: GameTrailers
description: Static Dread: The Submarine is available now on Steam. Watch the Static Dread: The Submarine launch trailer for this psychological horror game. In Static Dread: The Submarine, descend into Lovecraftian horror aboard a claustrophobic military submarine. Assign tasks as a captain’s right hand, analyze sonar signals, make hard decisions, and keep the crew from madness. Dark horrors lurk both within… and beyond the hull.
title: Static Dread: The Submarine - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: See what's coming in Version 4.5 of Honkai: Star Rail in this latest trailer for the space fantasy RPG, including a new racing grand prix, events, rewards, and more. Honkai: Star Rail is available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (HoYoPlay and Epic Games Store).
title: Honkai: Star Rail - Official Version 4.5: To Roll the Stars in Astropolis Trailer

description:
Join Sophia and get another peek into the story of Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy in this latest trailer for the upcoming action-adventure game. In Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy, there's a fine line between Myth and Reality. Navigate intertwined stories and unravel the mysteries of the Minotaur's Island, across the ages.

Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) on August 27, 2026.
title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - Official 'Between Myth and Reality' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into what you can expect from Update 2.0 in this new STALKER 2: Heart of Chornobyl trailer for the FPS game. Update 2.0 for STALKER 2: Heart of Chornobyl features a new version of the engine, a graphic overhaul with visual improvements, three types of binoculars, and more. Update 2.0 for STALKER 2: Heart of Chornobyl launches on August 20, 2026, alongside the Cost of Hope expansion.

Update 2.0 overhauls the Zone's lighting and visuals with improved lighting and reworked landscapes and foliage. A-Life improvements include more believable activity and encounters in the Zone, with more contested points of interest. The new update will also introduce Custom Rules, allowing you to tailor the difficulty to your preferred playstyle. You can also try Master difficulty and the optional Expedition mode.

In addition to three new binoculars, four new weapons are available in the arsenal, including the Arev assault rifle, the GP3A designated marksman rifle, the SKP designated mar
title: STALKER 2: Heart of Chornobyl - Official Update 2.0: Back to the Zone Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Time Distortionists announcement trailer for this upcoming turn-based strategy game about managing a collapsing timeline across thirteen billion years. Scan history, deploy specialized agents, build a base outside causality, and decide what can be saved when every intervention reshapes the future. Time Distortionists will be available on PC via Steam.
title: Time Distortionists - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Project Revenant is a new 2D side-scrolling action shooter built around a precision-aiming system. Meaning, shots only deal damage when the cursor is directly over an enemy’s hitbox, allowing players to deliberately target enemies behind the front line. Try it out for yourself in the playtest on August 26 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3850590/Project_Revenant/
title: Project Revenant: Official Playtest Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Discover terrifying threats you'll face as you dive into the Illuminate Void in this latest Helldivers 2 trailer for the third-person action co-op shooter game. Helldivers 2 is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

From the trailer's official description: 

"Territorial Reclamation Initiative authorized. 

Peaceful worlds are suffering inside an expanding Void of reality-warping distortion… a deceitful design of the ink-stained Illuminate infiltrators! 

Planets corrupted. Citizens lost. Natural law violated.

You’ve been cleared for exploratory insertion. Dive into the Illuminate Void, reclaim our worlds, and restore Managed Democracy."
title: Helldivers 2 - Official Devoid of Liberty: Uncover the Truth Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Plan B: Terraform trailer for the sci-fi planetary base-building sim game to see what to expect with the Worlds of Fire and Water DLC, along with the free update 1.1. The Worlds of Fire and Water DLC features Fire World, with constant volcano eruptions, mineral-rich basalt, geysers and condensators. It also features Water World, with a few tiny islands a world covered in water, along with polluted water and filters. The free update 1.1 features a tech tree, ugrades, dynamic ice cap, shade and mirror satellites, ice comets, sea plants and plankton, water farm, small ship, airship, GHG neutralization factory, drone extractor, and floating extractor. The Worlds of Fire and Water DLC and the free update 1.1 for Plan B: Terraform will be available on Steam on September 23, 2026.

Terraform a lifeless rock into a lush and habitable world in Plan B: Terraform. Build trucks, trains, and sprawling factories on an enormous hexagonal planet. Grow its population to millions. Enjo
title: Plan B: Terraform - Official Worlds Of Fire And Water DLC Trailer
